Tavern and grill house · Peyia, Paphos

Meze next to the church in Peyia

The Old Cinema Tavern is next to the church on Peyia square. Traditional meze and Cyprus cuisine, as the sign says. On Google, 4.5 stars from 469 reviews.

Food

Meze and the grill

What guests write about in their Google reviews.

Meze

45 Google reviews mention the meze. One guest picked from the meze menu and found everything delicious.

From the grill

A grill house, as the sign says. Guests write that the grilled local meat comes fresh and juicy straight off the grill. 4 reviews mention the lamb chops.

Moussaka and Greek salad

9 Google reviews mention the moussaka, 6 the Greek salad. One guest found the salad big enough for four.

Portions

Service

Guests write about great service, friendly service and a great vibe.

Cypriot tavern

17 Google reviews call it a Cypriot tavern, 4 mention traditional Cypriot food.

In Peyia

At Grigori Afxentiou 2, next to the church on Peyia square. Open every day 17:00-23:00. Takeaway too, as the sign says: call 96 703799.
